questions: Are all cars moving at exactly the same speed, or could there be variation in speeds among cars?
Do cars start at specific positions (e.g., equally spaced) or just 'very far from each other' in some unspecified arrangement?
Is 'encounter' defined as passing through the same point at the same instant, or just coming arbitrarily close?
Are the two sets of cars initially interleaved or completely separated on opposite sides?
Should we count multiple encounters between the same pair if they pass through each other and later meet again?
Does 'very far from each other' imply they start in sorted order within each group?
Are cars considered dimensionless points or do they have length that affects collision detection?
Is the road one-dimensional with no passing, or can cars overtake others going the same direction?
